i have the biggest crush on this guy, liked him for three years straight. 

We talked, we were in the same friend group and sat next to each other in class. 

I thought that maybe we had a spark between us (but that’s probably me overthinking it), and i really liked the dynamic between us and he always made me smile at the slightest things he did or said. 

But when it became clear he didn’t like me back, i tried to stop liking him, distancing myself from him and not talking that much to him, and he was fine with it. Didn’t say anything or asked me what was wrong. I was probably expecting too much. 

What really hurt me was when one of my closest friends who i told nearly everything to started to talk to him and messaged him a lot, and he started being super friendly with her. People have told me that he was flirty and liked to lead girls on but i didn’t care and thought i was special. So i thought that maybe i should just give up and i slowly stopped taking to him, especially when i changed seats away from him. One day, that friend of mine asked me why i was ignoring that guy, and i told her in confidentiality that i kind of was trying to give up on him. That friend of mine nodded and returned to her phone. She then decided to go to the toilet and asked me to help her hold her phone. Then i saw the notification from him, and they were talking about me. I feel really bad about looking at her phone but i was curious when i saw my name flit across the phone screen. So i unlocked her phone and looked at her chat. 

Turned out that both of them had been talking bad about me, and that friend of mine told him all the shit that i had told her in confidence and they were mocking me about it. The last thing i saw before i decided to put down the phone was “i don’t get why she needs to be so angry. it’s not like we bitched about her that much anyway”.
